name: stop-slop
title_zh: 删掉「首先」「其次」「总之」的 AI 味检测器
tagline_zh: 给文章做一次「人味体检」：揪出 ChatGPT 最爱的连接词、空洞强调和排比套路。改完像人写的，不是像机器吐的。
tagline_en: A human-voice checkup for your drafts: catches ChatGPT's favorite connectors, empty intensifiers, and formulaic.
desc_en: Remove AI writing patterns from prose. Use when drafting, editing, or reviewing text to eliminate predictable AI tells.
why_zh: 不是简单替换同义词，而是识别 AI 的句法指纹——那些人类几乎不用的过渡词和对称结构。
why_en: It targets syntactic fingerprints—transitions and parallel structures humans rarely use—then suggests plainer, more natural.
limit_zh: 只处理英文散文文本，不碰代码、诗歌或对话体；需要你逐条确认改动，不会自动重写整段。
limit_en: English prose only; no code, poetry, or dialogue. Requires per-item confirmation—no auto-rewrites. May false-positive on deliberate AI-style parody.
title_en: Strip AI tells from your prose
